text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Ikuno Dictus's classmates dropping 
out of the running one after another due 
to injuries, the Trainer hesitated over 
whether to enter her in the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Enter a fierce race, or sit it out to 
condition her body for a longer career? 
While fretting over the choice, Ines Fujin 
called out to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She stated that she had no regrets about 
her run in the Japanese Derby. Back then, 
she wanted to win even if it meant putting 
everything on the line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Confirming Ikuno Dictus's intentions once 
more: putting everything on the line to 
win, and racing for a long time. She 
replied that her goal is to accomplish 
both.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was an unshakeable iron will— The 
Trainer brushed aside all doubt and 
resolved to head toward the Shuka Sho.
